'''G.M. Berlotti''' is a character in the [[3D Universe]] who is mentioned in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]].

==Character history==
G.M. Berlotti is an author with one of his books, "[[The Space Gem]]", be found in a number of [[Save Points in GTA San Andreas|safehouses]].

==Trivia==
*The 'G.M' may be a reference to [[United States of America|American]] car manufacturer [[:wp:General Motors|General Motors Company]].
